verdict.rationale: Netlify is a deployment and hosting platform, so multi-protocol serving is a fair axis for it. The evidence only covers HTTP-based hosting: a CDN, serverless functions and automatic HTTPS. Nothing documents TCP, gRPC or WebSocket traffic from one deployed service without separate protocol configuration, and partial support for HTTP alone does not deliver the story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can serve HTTP, TCP, gRPC, and WebSocket traffic from the same deployed service without separate protocol configuration
